# Third-party components

The plugin includes modified ComfyUI, Kitchen and SageAttention source. Root `LICENSE`
is GPL-3.0-or-later for the combined plugin. Individual kernel licenses and original
copyright notices remain in force; see [licensing](../docs/LICENSING.md) and the
[file index](../evidence/kernel-provenance.json).

- `GPL-3.0.txt`: ComfyUI-derived model/VAE integration.
- `APACHE-2.0.txt`: Kitchen, SGLang and original kernel adaptations.
- `SAGEATTENTION-LICENSE.txt`: dense-attention ancestry.
- `CUTLASS-LICENSE.txt`: C++ headers used at build time (download separately).
- `PYTORCH_LICENSE`: normalization reduction ancestry.

Model licenses are separate. No model weights or private business media are distributed.
